# Errors

Why a time zone could not be loaded.

<h2 id="time-zone-error"><code>TimeZoneError</code></h2>

```rux
pub enum TimeZoneError: uint8 {
    NotFound = 1,
    InvalidName = 2,
    InvalidData = 3,
    InvalidRule = 4,
    Unreadable = 5,
    OutOfMemory = 6
}
```

Why a time zone could not be loaded or built. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/TimeZone/Src/Error.rux#L5)

**Cases**

| Name          | Value | Description                                                                                        |
| ------------- | ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NotFound`    | `1`   | No zone of that name was found in any time-zone directory.                                         |
| `InvalidName` | `2`   | The name is not one a zone can have: empty, absolute, or reaching outside the directory with `..`. |
| `InvalidData` | `3`   | The zone's data is not a well-formed TZif file.                                                    |
| `InvalidRule` | `4`   | A POSIX `TZ` rule is malformed.                                                                    |
| `Unreadable`  | `5`   | The zone's file could not be read for a reason other than its absence.                             |
| `OutOfMemory` | `6`   | The allocator could not supply the storage.                                                        |
